# Section 4.

## Draw Lognormal model posterior samples

```{r}
nna_idx = which(!is.na(progression$RNNEWLES_lb))
boundsyz = array(
  c(
    progression$PSPCRIT_lb[nna_idx], progression$RNNEWLES_lb[nna_idx],
    progression$PSPCRIT_rb[nna_idx], progression$RNNEWLES_rb[nna_idx]
  ),
  dim=c(length(nna_idx), 2, 2)
) %>%
  do(\(arr){
    arr[,,1] = pmin(arr[,,1], 1000)
    arr[,,2] = pmin(arr[,,2], 2000)
    arr
  })
x = model.matrix(
  ~.,
  data=progression[nna_idx,colnames(progression)%in%colnames(progression)[10:18]]
)
```

## Lognormal model posterior diagnostics

```{r}
posterior_diagnostics_lorgnorm = function(post_chains, param, idx1, idx2, lag_max=50) {
  post_chains %>%
    lapply(\(p)p[[param]][idx1,idx2,]) %>%
    do(\(l)do.call(posterior_diagnostics, append(l, c(lag_max = lag_max)))) %>%
    do(\(l){
      l$plots = patchwork::wrap_plots(list(
        l$trace_plot + ggtitle(paste0(param, "[", idx1, ",", idx2, "] trace plot")),
        l$acf_plot + ggtitle(paste0(param, "[", idx1, ",", idx2, "] ACF plot"))
      ), ncol=2)
      l$trace_plot = NULL
      l$acf_plot = NULL
      l
    })
}
for (idx in 1:14) {
  for (yz in 1:2) {
    print(posterior_diagnostics_lorgnorm(lognorm_posterior_chains, "betayz", idx, yz))
  }
}
posterior_diagnostics_lorgnorm(lognorm_posterior_chains, "Sigmayz", 1, 1)
posterior_diagnostics_lorgnorm(lognorm_posterior_chains, "Sigmayz", 1, 2)
posterior_diagnostics_lorgnorm(lognorm_posterior_chains, "Sigmayz", 2, 2)
```

# Section 5.

## Plot regression coefficient posteriors

```{r}
plot_beta_densities_lorgnorm = function(post_chains, idx) {
  post_chains %>%
    lapply(\(p)p$betayz[idx,,]) %>%
    do.call(cbind, .) %>%
    t() %>%
    setColnames(paste0(c("betay", "betaz"), idx)) %>%
    as.data.frame.table() %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(Parameter = Var2, Posterior = Freq, .keep="none") %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_density(aes(x=Posterior, fill=Parameter), alpha=0.7) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Posterior distributions of betay", idx, " and betaz", idx)) +
    ylab("Density") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("salmon", "lightblue")) +
    theme_bw()
}
for (idx in 1:14) print(plot_beta_densities_lorgnorm(lognorm_posterior_chains, idx))
```

```{r}
cat("Regression parameter vector posterior means (sd):\n")
arrapply(1:14, 1:2, f=\(idx1, idx2){
  lognorm_posterior_chains %>%
    lapply(\(p)p$betayz[idx1,idx2,]) %>%
    do.call(c, .) %>%
    do(\(x)paste0(round(mean(x), 4), " (", round(sd(x), 4), ")"))
}) %>%
  setDimnames(1:14, paste0("beta", c("y", "z"))) %>%
  do(\(mat)cbind(colnames(x), mat)) %>%
  noquote()

cat("\nRegression parameter vector posterior 95% credible intervals:\n")
arrapply(1:14, 1:2, f=\(idx1, idx2){
  lognorm_posterior_chains %>%
    lapply(\(p)p$betayz[idx1,idx2,]) %>%
    do.call(c, .) %>%
    do(\(x)unname(round(quantile(x, probs=c(0.025, 0.975)), 4))) %>%
    do(\(x)paste0("(", x[1], ", ", x[2], ")"))
}) %>%
  setDimnames(1:14, paste0("beta", c("y", "z"))) %>%
  do(\(mat)cbind(colnames(x), mat)) %>%
  noquote()
```

```{r}
lognorm_posterior_chains %>%
  lapply(\(p)p$Sigmayz[1,2,]/sqrt(p$Sigmayz[1,1,]*p$Sigmayz[2,2,])) %>%
  do.call(c, .) %>%
  do(\(rho){
    tibble(`Partial Correlation` = rho) %>%
      ggplot() +
      geom_density(aes(x=`Partial Correlation`), fill="lightblue", alpha=0.7) +
      geom_label(
        aes(x=x, y=y, label=label),
        data=tibble(
          x=-0.5,
          y=5,
          label=paste0("mean (sd) = ", round(mean(rho), 4), " (", round(sd(rho), 4), ")")
        )
      ) +
      geom_label(
        aes(x=x, y=y, label=label),
        data=tibble(
          x=-0.5,
          y=4.5,
          label=unname(round(quantile(rho, probs=c(0.025, 0.975)), 4)) %>%
            do(\(x)paste0("95% credible interval: (", x[1], ", ", x[2], ")"))
        )
      ) +
      ggtitle("Posterior distribution of Y,Z outcomes' partial correlation given X") +
      ylab("Density") +
      xlim(c(-1, 1)) +
      theme_bw()
  })
```
